name: Nabari (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Nabari city emblem in white: a stylised device of a loop and an angular stroke, like a bird.
history: Municipal flag of Nabari, a city in Mie Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 2 October 1972; the emblem dates from 1 June 1954.

features.role: Nabari city emblem — a stylised device of a loop and an angular stroke, like a bird
